upheld.title: New fifth column narrows existing columns; dates now wrap
upheld.detail: Each `.orders-item > div` has `flex: 1 0 0`, so the new actions column takes an equal fifth of the 56rem list. Each column shrinks from about 203px to about 157px and every date ('11/02/2026 10:00:00') wraps onto two lines, changing how the existing columns look.
upheld.requirement: CANC-1 AC5: number, date, total and status are shown on My orders as today

upheld.title: Message box text color is overridden to gray
upheld.detail: The existing `.orders > p` rule (color --color-ink-2, font-size --text-lg) is more specific than the new `.orders-message` once Blazor scopes the CSS, so the alert text comes out gray and large on a red-tint background with a red border, unlike the danger messages on Cart and Checkout.
upheld.requirement: Design system: match existing danger/error message styling (CartPage.razor.css:223-228, Checkout.razor.css:66)

upheld.title: Rows with a Cancel button are taller than the rest
upheld.detail: The secondary button's height makes cancellable rows about 85px tall against about 72px for the other rows, so the list's row rhythm is uneven.
upheld.requirement: Design system: new UI must look like it belongs in the existing orders list

upheld.title: Dead CancelOrderCommand branch in IdentifiedCommandHandler; logging copied into the cancel handler
upheld.detail: CancelOrderIdentifiedCommandHandler stops extending IdentifiedCommandHandler on purpose: it saves the request only after a successful cancel and lets errors through. As a result, `case CancelOrderCommand` in the base switch can no longer run. The duplicate check and the two log calls are also copied
upheld.requirement: No dead code or duplicated logic (critic guideline 2)

upheld.title: cancelMessage also carries the load-failure message
upheld.detail: The field is named for cancel results, but LoadOrdersAsync also puts the 'couldn't load your orders' error in it, and the template uses it to hide the loading state. The name says something different from what the field holds.
upheld.requirement: Naming matches what the code does (critic guideline 1)

upheld.title: GetGenericTypeName() computed twice in the new handler
upheld.detail: The copied logging calls command.GetGenericTypeName() once for each log line. The base class it was copied from computes commandName once and reuses it.
